title: Config Manager (Nodes & Subscriptions)
summary: Local node store for single share links and subscription links. Configs live in /etc/daypass/proxy/configs and the header shows the active transport engine.

items.title: List Configs
items.description: Shows every saved config with its protocol, ON/OFF state and the subscription it came from.
items.usage_tip: Run it first to learn the exact config names used by other options.

items.title: Add Manual Config
items.description: Saves one share link under a name you choose and detects the protocol automatically.
items.usage_tip: Supported links: vless, vmess, trojan, ss and hysteria2.

items.title: Toggle Enable/Disable Config
items.description: Writes enabled=false or true into the config file.
items.usage_tip: Known issue: a stored false is read back as true, so the node still shows ON and is not skipped.

items.title: Add Subscription
items.description: Stores a subscription name and its URL for later updates.
items.usage_tip: Nothing is downloaded until you run Update All Subscriptions.

items.title: List Subscriptions
items.description: Lists saved subscriptions together with their last update time.
items.usage_tip: Use it to check when a subscription was refreshed last.

items.title: Update All Subscriptions
items.description: Downloads every subscription, accepts plain or base64 content and stores each link as a separate config.
items.usage_tip: Nodes from the same subscription are replaced on every update.

items.title: Push Config to Active Engine
items.description: Lists the configs and imports the one you name into the active engine (Passwall or Passwall2).
items.usage_tip: sing-box, Xray, WireGuard and OpenVPN nodes are managed in their own configs; a node whose name already exists is skipped.

items.title: Push All Configs to Active Engine
items.description: Imports every saved config into the active engine in one go.
items.usage_tip: Names already present are skipped, so updated links are not re-imported.

items.title: Remove Config
items.description: Lists the configs and deletes the one you confirm.
items.usage_tip: The balancer node list is not updated; re-select nodes after removing one.

items.title: Back
items.description: Returns to the Proxy & Routing Manager.
items.usage_tip: Stored configs and subscriptions are kept.
